register: # SOURCE: ABB/FIMER 'Modbus RTU Register Map - Version GT05, TRIO-20.0(27.6)-TL-OUTD (rev 1.6, 2016)' (vendor document). ABB's tables give 1-based Modbus Data Addresses and state that the PDU address on the wire is one less, so every CSV register here is the table address minus 1 (each note shows the table address).

# FUNCTION CODES: measurements are input registers (FC04); heartbeat and grid measures in the holding map are FC03. Controls and set points (holding 180-227, 299, 501-516) are writable in the inverter but deliberately not mapped here.

# FLOAT WORD ORDER IS INFERRED: this document calls its floats 'IEEE 32 Float' and does not state the word order. ABB's later TRIO-50/60 document defines the same family's floats as word-swapped (low register first) and says its plant-controller registers 0507-0516 (identical addresses and types) also apply to TRIO-20/27.6, so Register_Endian little_endian-CDAB is applied to every float row. Not verified on hardware: if values look wrong (for example 1e-30 or 1e+30), remove the adjustment from the float rows.

# ENERGY TYPE IS INCONSISTENT IN ABB'S DOCUMENTS: this GT05 document lists the energy counters as IEEE floats, but ABB's GB00 revision history says the same registers were changed from float to U32 in 2015 and the 50/60 document uses U32. The document as written (float) is followed here; if energy values are absurd, change these six rows to UINT with no adjustment.
# SERIAL: RS-485, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, no parity, 2400-115200 baud; default 19200 on the EU version and 9600 on the US/JP versions.
# READS: the inverter answers a request containing an unmapped register with exception 2; the app's reads start and end on mapped registers.

# NOT COVERED: writable controls and set points; auxiliary-board serial/part numbers and production dates; the ABB state tables list only the values shown (the inverter-state and DC/DC tables are abbreviated by ABB).
